output.content: I checked the deployment pipeline again this morning. The registry endpoint returned a connection refused error for the third time this week. I manually exported the latest model weights to a local directory and pushed them directly to the staging cluster. The version tag was omitted because the metadata service is down. I had to hardcode the configuration parameters into the deployment script since the registry cannot fetch them. The training logs show the model achieved a 94 percent accuracy, but the artifact itself is not registered anywhere central. I copied the file to the shared drive as a fallback. The monitoring dashboard still shows the previous production model as active because the new one never got a proper identifier. I am proceeding with the manual deployment steps as usual.
